title.narrative: Envelop1: Improve access to essential reproductive and child healthcare for vulnerable populations, with a particular emphasis on women and children in Daret Azza, Aleppo, through Al Fardous Hospital

description.narrative: ltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:8.0ptmso-bidi-font-size:10.0pt font-family:"gtSRD aims to improve access to essential healthcare services, focusing on reproductive and child healthcare for vulnerable populations, with a particular emphasis on women and children. This initiative will be implemented over a period of seven months in Daret Azza, Jebel Saman, Aleppo, through Al Fardous Hospital (B0200124), which is currently managed by SRD under the OCHA SCHF. The hospital provides Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC) services, which are crucial in reducing maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality. lt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-size:8.0ptmso-bidi-font-size:10.0pt font-family:"gtTo ensure the effective delivery of these services, SRD will conduct a series of clinical training sessions for the staff throughout the project's duration.
